method.hash_and_path: Recomputed SHA-256 from exact bytes for every selected raw and Markdown file; checked all workspace-relative paths, source URL commit pins where applicable, UTF-8 decoding, BOM absence, and LF-only clean files.
method.pdf: Independently extracted each born-digital PDF with pdftotext -layout, checked first/last substantive units and source-order section presence, and measured unique source 6-token-shingle coverage in clean text. This check is insensitive to removed running titles/page numbers but detects omitted body passages. Layout/table and continuation checks used the retained layout text directly.
method.smcl: Compared raw title-marker order, raw external browse URLs, syntax/table directives, continuation markers, first and last substantive units, and visible-SMCL residue against the cleaned Markdown. INCLUDE directives were separately enumerated and checked for same-commit raw availability and expansion at the source location.
